ns2:course.label: Exploring Paris
ns2:course.description: Examines the role of Paris at the heart of French culture and the idea of the "French exception." Focus will be on the city and its representation in French culture. Attention will be given to Parisian notions of food, the arts, sexualities, and the role of the individual. All readings are in English. All films will be shown with subtitles. No knowledge of French required.
